sec.title: Introduction
sec.p: Heart failure is common1 and costly in older adults worldwide.

sec.title: Methods
sec.p: This was a randomized, double-blind, placebo-controlled trial (NCT01234567) of drug X in adults.

sec.title: Study population
sec.p: We randomized 200 participants; 5 were lost to follow-up before the primary analysis.

sec.title: Primary outcome
sec.p: The primary outcome occurred less often with drug X (hazard ratio 0.74, 95% CI 0.63-0.88; P<0.001).

caption.title: Survival.
caption.p: Kaplan-Meier curves for the primary outcome.

sec.title: Discussion
sec.p: Limitations include the short follow-up and single-country enrolment.

ack.p: The authors thank the trial participants and coordinators for their time.
